//: Granola, the first keyed recorder (D78): one `schedule` job runs once per member who pasted their own Granola key, lists only the folders that member ticked, and hands each note to Content.logRecordedNote — the host matches it to the calendar meeting or births a call. A note that left every ticked folder, or that Granola deleted, is handed back as gone. Typed notes and the transcript are fetched only when the member opted in. Depends on @spaces/sdk only; effect and zod are peers the host provides.
name: @spaces/plugin-granola
